channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Zeke Nnaji | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Zeke Nnaji from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Michael Malone on Zeke Nnaji, Bones Hyland
item.description:
Harrison Wind:Michael Malone on Bones Hyland's ankle that he tweaked last night in Dallas, via @AltitudeSR:

“I don't think it's anything serious. But at the same time, I didn't think Zeke Nnaji's ankle was anything serious, but he missed last night.”

Michael Malone on Zeke Nnaji, Bones Hyland, Nov 16, 2021. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: Michael Malone on RJ Hampton, Zeke Nnaji
item.description:
Harrison Wind:Malone on the mounting injuries & Hampton/Nnaji's increased roles:

“Those are the breaks. That's part of it. You don't complain about it. You just find guys who want to go out there and compete and fight like hell. RJ and Zeke every chance they've gotten have done exactly that.”

Michael Malone on RJ Hampton, Zeke Nnaji, Feb 14, 2021. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: Tim Connelly on Zeke Nnaji
item.description:
Harrison Wind:Connelly on Zeke Nnaji:

“He's extremely intelligent, a maniacal worker....really, really smart guy. I think he's got a motor, you don't have to turn him up which is great. We saw eight or nine guys work out. It was impressive to see how big he was for a 19-year-old kid.”

Tim Connelly on Zeke Nnaji, Nov 19, 2020. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.
